notes.title: Update 1.1.9 available for PC and Linux (Mac version coming soon)
notes.notes:
Syntherapy Update 1.1.9 is currently live for PC and Linux users, and a version for Macs should be going live in the next few days. 

The main new feature of this update is French localization for in-game text and dialogue. With the new system created to handle this update, new languages should be far easier to implement going forward. Be sure to let us know if there are particular languages you'd like us to add!

Other fixes include:


 Updating fonts to allow for additional characters. 
 A bug where the game would lock up if the Enter key was pressed multiple times during loading screens has been fixed.
 A bug that caused voice lines to occasionally echo has been fixed.
 A bug where selecting the Ending Challenge mode but then going back to the main menu broke the selection slots has been fixed.
 Text formatting issues throughout the game have been fixed.


We're still working on our next big update for the game, which we intend to unveil on the three year anniversary of Syntherapy's release!

notes.title: Version 1.1.86 released for all platforms
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.86 has been released to all platforms!

The previous version featured a bug during the 'mantra' sequence in session 2. That has now been fixed.

More importantly, 1.1.86 is now available for all versions, including Macs! Going forward, all updates will ship out to all platforms at the same time now that we have a consistent method to compile builds on Apple systems.

With that issue resolved, we're aiming to begin development on some more ambitious updates to Syntherapy that will add more content to the game. We'll have more information on the content of that update available in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Update 1.1.85
notes.notes:
For quite some time, a bug has existed in Syntherapy wherein during a chapter midway through the game, a segment that faded to black would not progress properly to the next section. This bug proved difficult to fix as it did not show up during any playtests on our end. Since it did not result in a crash, no error logs could be used either.

The source of this problem, as has been mentioned in previous posts, was due to changes brought about by updating Gamemaker's software. Identifying the exact issue proved difficult. In the end, a complete overhaul of the game code was required in order to completely restructure how transitions were handled. This took some time not just to implement, but also to test, and until recently finding time required to do this was difficult. This situation has now improved considerably, and now updates should come more quickly.

Unfortunately this update is currently only available for PC and Linux. The hardware we used for the Mac version is no longer capable of compiling builds. We are working to find a solution for this and hope to have a Mac version of 1.1.85 out soon.

We have also addressed an issue where there is no chapter 1 save point, and the first save point comes after the end of your first meeting with Tara. We have added a save point to the first time you access the email hub, which would allow players to skip past the intro and email hub tutorial.

Various issues related to text resizing and other problems have also been fixed.

We apologize for how long this update took to materialize, but we wanted to make sure that it worked properly before putting it out. If there are problems, please leave comments in our Steam forum to let us know so that we can fix them!

notes.title: Update Version 1.1.8 for Windows
notes.notes: This patch fixes the bug that prevents autoplay progress after the night time phonecall scene for Windows users. A similar patch for Mac users will be released tomorrow!

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Earlier this week we put out an update, version 1.1.1. The update focused on fixing some bugs that had been caused by our previous update.


 A bug preventing additional therapies from being chosen in the report menu has been fixed.
 A bug in the Mac version that crashed the game after choosing additional therapies has been fixed.


Yesterday we added onto this with update version 1.1.2. In this new update we added more dialogue paths to the flowchart.

notes.title: Syntherapy Version 1.1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
The biggest update in Version 1.1.0 is a new game mode, Therapist Mode.

In this mode, you are randomly assigned a treatment outcome. Using hints provided in the game, you need to find out what that treatment outcome is, and then work to achieve it in order to get a good ending! This game mode is only available to people who have beaten the game.

As a part of this update, we've added some other features to the game.


 Your journal now keeps track of what additional therapies you used in previous sessions.
 The Report app in the computer hub now has an additional window that tells you what character relationships and therapies will help you achieve a good ending with different treatment outcomes.
 More options have been added to the flowchart.


This will likely be our last update for the year. Thanks to everyone who has been playing through Syntherapy so far, and we look forward to seeing you all in 2021 with more content updates!

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.0.09
notes.notes:
The following updates are in Syntherapy Update 1.0.09:


 When choices are made, a popup will indicate how many points you earned and with which character. 
 A bug causing the butterflies to not appear at the start of the room has been fixed
 A bug causing the textbox trust levels to differ from the journal trust levels has been fixed
 A crush issue in the flowchart has been fixed

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.0.08
notes.notes:
Late Saturday, we pushed update 1.0.08. New features and updates include:


 Added Concept Art Scavenger Hunt feature which allows you to unlock concept art after finding objects in the background.
 More flowchart decisions added
 Save file bug fixed


In the coming week we'll be working to better improve these features!

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.0.07
notes.notes:
In yesterday's update to Syntherapy version 1.0.07, the following changes have been added:


 The flowchart can now be accessed from the main menu and access all save files.
 The main menu now has full keyboard controls
 The hub menu now has full keyboard controls
 A new option that randomizes character loyalty stats has been added to the chapter select menu

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.0.06
notes.notes:
Yesterday we put out update 1.0.06 for PC, Mac and Linux! The main feature of this update is:


A flowchart reader that lets you see what choices you made and what additional choices can be made


There are some additional features we plan to add to this flowchart reader which will be available this coming Tuesday on November 17th. These updates are:


The option to open the flowchart reader from the main menu in order to look at any individual save file's flowchart
Add more information on what points you earn through each choice


In the future we will also be adding a feature to the flowchart that can help players learn what stats they need in order to achieve all of the different endings. Our plan is to have this feature unlock for players once they have achieved at least one ending.

notes.title: Syntherapy Update 1.0.05
notes.notes:
In today's update to Syntherapy, version 1.0.05, we've added a quality of life update to the in-game dialogue box.

Now when you play through Syntherapy, there are several tabs attached to the dialogue box. Clicking them will allow the player to see several different bits of information, including:


Current objectives
Character loyalty stats
A list of hidden objects the player has found


In addition to this new feature, we have also fixed some minor bugs, including:


Lines of dialogue that weren't playing after fade-to-black transitions now work
Issues with the dialogue spreadsheet were fixed


A lot of this week was spent laying the code base for Syntherapy's flowcharts, which will be coming out in next week's update! All choice progress should be saved from now on and will be visible in next week's update.

Thank you for continuing to play Syntherapy and we look forward to showing off our biggest update yet next week with the flowcharts!

notes.title: Syntherapy Version 1.0.04
notes.notes:
Syntherapy Version 1.0.04 is here and brings two new features to the game!

Syntherapy now has an option to let you play minigames from the main menu. We also have changed it so that starting a new game on a fresh save slot now gives you the option of starting the game at any chapter you've previously unlocked!

Overall, here are the changes for Syntherapy Version 1.0.04:


 Minigames are playable from the main menu
 You can now play a game from any previously encountered chapter through the chapter select menu
 Errors in the spreadsheet causing dialogue loops have been fixed
 Bugs effecting Syntherapy's endings have been fixed
 Problems with the Neurofeedback minigame arrow buttons not appearing have been fixed


Next week's update, Version 1.0.05, will include objective tabs on your textbox to help you keep track of what's going on in the game during dialogue sections!

We hope you enjoy the new update to Syntherapy and we'll see you next week!

notes.title: Version 1.0.03 is now live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.03 of Syntherapy is live!

The new additions to this build include:


 The skip dialogue button has been reintroduced!
 Steam screenshots are now a feature of the game.
 The game now supports up to 4k resolution.


There are also several bugfixes included in this version, including:


 A bug where accessing the music player would cause crashes has been fixed.
 All bugs caused from pressing the D or Right arrow key repeatedly have been fixed
 Minor bugs in the spreadsheet causing unusual dialogue loops have been fixed
 Bugs involving some of the game's endings not progressing properly have been fixed
 Willow's Last Song for some of the endings now works as intended

notes.title: Version 1.0.02 bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.02 is now live for Windows!

This updated build contains bugfixes for:


The music volume settings caused game crashes due to an undeclared variable. This was caused by removing an audiogroup from the game but forgetting to take the reference out of the options.
Some of the endings weren't transitioning properly and have been fixed.
Some lines of dialogue were missing and have been put back in


More updates will be out in the coming days!
